active_profile.description: Software-in-the-loop planning/analysis on the conserved numpy authority; no rover, no live command.

runtime_profile.note: the persisted SIM/plan runs execute on desktop_sil (conserved numpy authority, evidence_class forecast, can_release/can_execute False); only hil/field_test/live_rover carry live command authority and are not exercised on this SIM path.

registry.description: Software-in-the-loop planning/analysis on the conserved numpy authority; no rover, no live command.
The observed digital twin: forecasts + belief, read-only, no command egress.
Deterministic bag/MCAP replay through the ROS2 spine; evidence only, no live command.
Gazebo robot/sensor simulation (ROS2-native: URDF/SDF, ros2_control, sensor plugins on real ROS topics); drives the SIM rover under truth-isolated sim_truth, never the real rover.

Godot/viz2 terrain + excavation simulation on the conserved mass-exact authority (real DEM, lunar photometry, driveable over a private loopback seam); drives the SIM rover under truth-isolated sim_truth, never the real rover.
Hardware-in-the-loop on a bench rover; bounded live actuation under the SF-01 safing watchdog.
Bounded field traverse on real hardware; live telemetry + bounded command under release authority.
Full live rover command in the live namespace; release + execute under the complete authority chain.
